knowledge_point.title: Determining the Dimensions of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix $X$, where
$X = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 5 \\ \sqrt{2} & 0 \\ \frac{1}{3} & -3\end{bmatrix}?$
The dimensions of $X$ are {{field-1}} $\times$ {{field-2}}.
question.:question/worked-solution: The matrix $X$ has $3$ rows and $2$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $3\times 2.$
